title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now available on AWS
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now generally available on AWS, giving enterprises a new path to build with OpenAI through the AWS environments, controls, and procurement work...
body:
OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now generally available on AWS, giving enterprises a new path to build with OpenAI through the AWS environments, controls, and procurement workflows they already use. Customers can get started with OpenAI on AWS and move faster from evaluation to production.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [OpenAI News](https://openai.com/index/openai-frontier-models-and-codex-are-now-available-on-aws).

Stay tuned to [Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in) for real-time model analysis and benchmark coverage.
